story_structure.value: The Two Numbers (lane structure, named): adoption climbs (L2–L3), then the second number from the SAME survey turns the piece (L4) — the wow is that both numbers are true at once, about the same people. Villain (N-06), named: The Hand-Check — (1) every output is re-verified manually, so the speed the tool promised leaks away in checking; (2) the checking knowledge lives in the developer's head and habits, not in a system — it cannot be reused, shared, or improved as an asset. (The dead solution is named by L5's shape: a better model is not the missing piece — the missing piece is the layer around whichever model.) Intended feeling: respect, then recognition — the fastest adopters are the least fooled; here is the work they do by hand that a layer should be doing.
